mapper.select: with post_counts as ( select series_id, count(*) as cnt from series_posts sp inner join posts p on p.id = sp.post_id where p.is_published_yn = 'Y' group by series_id ), media as ( select a.record_id, b.key, b.metadata from attachments a left join blobs b on b.id = a.blob_id where a.record_type = 'series' and a.name = 'thumbnail' ) select s.id , s.slug , s.name , s.description , s.published_at , s.status , coalesce(pc.cnt, 0) as post_count , m.key as thumbnail_key , m.metadata as thumbnail_metadata from series s left join post_counts pc on pc.series_id = s.id left join media m on m.record_id = text(s.id) order by case s.status when 'COMPLETED' then 1 when 'PROGRESS' then 2 when 'PLAN' then 3 else 4 end, s.created_at desc

with media as ( select a.record_type , a.record_id , b.key , b.metadata from attachments a inner join blobs b on b.id = a.blob_id where a.name = 'thumbnail' ), comment_counts as ( select post_id, count(*) as cnt from comments where deleted_at is null group by post_id ), post_list as ( select p.id , p.slug , p.title , p.summary , p.view_count , m.key as thumbnail_key , m.metadata as thumbnail_metadata , coalesce(cc.cnt, 0) as comment_count from posts p left join media m on m.record_id = text(p.id) and m.record_type = 'post' left join comment_counts cc on cc.post_id = p.id where p.is_published_yn = 'Y' ) select s.id , s.slug , s.name , s.description , s.status , s.published_at , sm.key as thumbnail_key , sm.metadata as thumbnail_metadata , p.id as post_id , p.slug as post_slug , p.title as post_title , p.summary as post_summary , p.view_count as post_view_count , p.comment_count as post_comment_count , p.thumbnail_key as post_thumbnail_key , p.thumbnail_metadata as post_thumbnail_metadata from series s left join media sm on sm.record_id = text(s.id) and sm.record_type = 'series' left join series_posts sp on sp.series_id = s.id left join post_list p on p.id = sp.post_id where s.slug = #{slug} and s.is_published_yn = 'Y' order by sp."order" desc

with series_base as ( select s.id as series_id , s.slug as series_slug , s.name as series_name , s.status as series_status , sp."order" as raw_order from series_posts sp inner join series s on s.id = sp.series_id where sp.post_id = #{postId} and s.is_published_yn = 'Y' limit 1 ), series_posts_ordered as ( select sp.post_id , sp."order" , p.slug , p.title , row_number() over (order by sp."order" desc) as display_order from series_posts sp inner join posts p on p.id = sp.post_id inner join series_base sb on sp.series_id = sb.series_id where p.is_published_yn = 'Y' ), series_info as ( select sb.series_id , sb.series_slug , sb.series_name , sb.series_status , sb.raw_order , spo.display_order as current_order from series_base sb inner join series_posts_ordered spo on spo.post_id = #{postId} ), total as ( select count(*) as cnt from series_posts_ordered ), prev_post as ( select spo.post_id as id, spo.slug, spo.title from series_posts_ordered spo inner join series_info si on true where spo."order" > si.raw_order order by spo."order" asc limit 1 ), next_post as ( select spo.post_id as id, spo.slug, spo.title from series_posts_ordered spo inner join series_info si on true where spo."order" < si.raw_order order by spo."order" desc limit 1 ), media as ( select a.record_id, b.key, b.metadata from attachments a inner join blobs b on b.id = a.blob_id where a.record_type = 'series' and a.name = 'thumbnail' ) select si.series_id , si.series_slug , si.series_name , si.series_status , m.key as thumbnail_key , m.metadata as thumbnail_metadata , t.cnt as total_count , si.current_order , pp.id as prev_id , pp.slug as prev_slug , pp.title as prev_title , np.id as next_id , np.slug as next_slug , np.title as next_title from series_info si cross join total t left join prev_post pp on true left join next_post np on true left join media m on m.record_id = text(si.series_id)
